name: kmj-codebridge
description: Secure, project-scoped AI coding across authorized computers and VPSs through one MCP bridge.

interface.longDescription: Connect AI-assisted development to approved projects on your laptops, workstations and VPSs through one authenticated MCP bridge. Inspect code, make guarded file changes, check Git state and run administrator-defined quality gates without exposing an unrestricted shell.
defaultPrompt: Inspect my authorized project with KMJ CodeBridge.
Show Git status and run my configured quality gates.
Check my CodeBridge connection and latest job results.
